meta.title: MC Thúy Vy - Bilingual Event Host
meta.description: MC Thúy Vy (Nguyễn Ngọc Thúy Vy) - bilingual Vietnamese-English event host who works without a script. 8+ years, 1,000+ events: galas, year-end parties, conferences, product launches and esports. Available nationwide.

a11y.home: MC Thúy Vy - back to top

greeting.title: Dear valued partners
greeting.body: Hosting a wide range of programmes for many different brands has given me a cross-industry foundation and a multi-faceted perspective, allowing me to quickly bring the right background knowledge to each type of event and to grasp every brief in depth. This is what keeps me steady as I lead and connect audiences across such a diverse range of occasions. It is a true honour to be trusted by our partners. I will bring my own signature style to convey the core values of every business, brand and product, and help create events that are impressive and truly memorable. With sincere gratitude!
greeting.portraitAlt: MC Thúy Vy in an evening gown

highlights.title: Highlights
items: MC lecturer at the HennaDa Community skills academy
Has hosted more than 1,000 events in Vietnam and internationally
Script-free host for major productions and bilingual MC (Grab Year-End Party 2022 "Shine The Night" - hosted without a script, delivering 6,000 words)
Esports MC and caster for many renowned game titles
Former VJ in collaboration with Kênh 14
Collaborates with TV and radio stations: HTV7, HTV9, HGV (Hậu Giang), THĐT (Đồng Tháp), VOH
Featured on the cover of Thanh Niên newspaper; guest speaker at talks and workshops
KOC with more than 50,000 followers on social media
